key_concepts: Sky objects can be natural or human-made
Natural things are not made by people
Fireworks, balloons, and helicopters are human-made sky objects
The Sun, Moon, stars, planets, and clouds are natural sky objects
Sky objects can be living or non-living
The Sun is bright and seen during the day
The Moon may be seen during the day and at night
Stars twinkle and begin to appear when the Sun sets
Planets look like stars in the night sky
Clouds have different appearances such as cirrus, cumulus, and nimbus
Nimbus clouds are dark, while cirrus and cumulus clouds are not dark or thin
